# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    شَرْطٌ / שָׁרְט / CONDITION        ║
║                                      ║
║    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━        ║
║                                      ║
║    if (شرط) {                        ║
║        תנאי = true;                  ║
║    }                                 ║
║                                      ║
║    ┌─────────────────────────┐       ║
║    │  the cut that binds     │       ║
║    │  the line that divides  │       ║
║    │  the mark that decides  │       ║
║    └─────────────────────────┘       ║
║                                      ║
║         ط                            ║
║        /|\                           ║
║       / | \                          ║
║      ש──┼──ת                         ║
║         |                            ║
║         ר                            ║
║                                      ║
║    stipulation │ incision │ premise  ║
║                                      ║
║    > awaiting condition_             ║
║    > parsing covenant_               ║
║    > scratching surface_             ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

the root speaks:
- **ש.ר.ט** — to scratch, to score, to mark
- **ش.ر.ط** — to stipulate, to condition, to cut

*what condition do you bring?*
